authority: Brice approves athlete-facing decisions. Route exceptions through the existing private queue. The current owner record and authorized readback determine status.

rules.line: Every surface has one job that owns it. Others hand work to that job; they never edit its surface.
Athletes hear one voice: B. No line reads as the app, a system or an assistant.
Nothing counts as done until it is read back in the athlete's own view, in the coach mirror.
Any job can mark a surface Stopped. Nothing new reaches that athlete there until it is Running again.
Every hand-off carries four things: what changed, why, what to check, what is still open.
When two surfaces disagree, the owning record is the truth. Fix the record first, then every surface that shows it.
No build or new surface reaches an athlete before Brice has used it for a day or two.

cadence.action: Put it on its session or race; the feed posts itself
Soreness or pain in the note opens a check-in the same day
Does it move a point or a pace? Revise or leave it
Change the version and the strength week together, rewrite the story, read it back in the mirror
Asks the athlete: Worse, Same, Better, Gone
Read YOUR EYE and the lights
Worse, or three days quiet: tell Brice. Gone: hand the stale scan to Voice
Write the journey: title, place, one line per runner
Next week's stories and Today lines, read against open check-ins
Run the audit, set every surface's light, hand anything Stopped to Brice
Write the race plan, then revise it after the last key session
Plan starts in the week they join; avatar live, code issued, race on the feed
Share the long runs people mention to Brice; Brice introduces who fits or asks the group
Brice lives with it for a day or two before anyone else gets it
